method: Actual view_image review of all five final batch59 PNGs, exact N1-S02/N5-S02/N14-S02/N18-S01 source passages and manifests; dimensions and output/source/reference SHA256 recomputed. Producer QA preserved.

findings: Intact hanging bronze bell remains visible, one rope end hangs beneath its clapper ring, and its neat diagonal compact cut face is enlarged and inspectable.
No cutting actor, blade, repair or returned person is shown. Exact attachment and cut geometry are proposals.
N1-S02 supports observation of the cut and intact bell only; it does not certify cutter, time, debt validity or other route outcomes.
One crate corner shows a broad flattened scar, paired narrow parallel marks and a curved edge scar. They span adjacent faces rather than one face; the source requires one corner, not one plane.

Three visually distinct marks are readable and are not N11 square-plus-three-line cargo code. Some edges look deeply gouged; clamp pressure as their cause is a narrative interpretation, not something this image independently authenticates.
Specific scar geometry is not source-defined. N5-S02 still requires dispatch duplicate plus track/cargo-tag comparison for each route; image alone identifies no culprit or full traffic history.
Rod exists in first frame and final hands withdraw, but final pin remains in separate storage block. No visible final locking transfer occurs.
Left rod shrinks between second and third views; continuous component movement is not valid.
First frame already contains both rod halves; final pin appears at lever carriage and former storage socket is visibly empty, with hands absent.

Left rod still visibly shortens between second and third frames. Right carriage displacement and lever rotation remain unclear, so opening the gap does not convincingly follow the intended moving-part action.

Pin contact is schematic; this is a three-tool sequence proposal, not an independently validated lock or safety procedure. N14-S02 expressly forbids claiming final apparatus safety from preparation alone.

Useful next deliverable: isolate fixed left rod and moving right carriage in a close-up with constant-length parts, two clearly different carriage positions and pin seated in aligned carriage/base hole.
Exactly three separate loose ends can be counted in each frame; the basket coil is disconnected from the workpiece, and a separate wooden rest supports the released work in frame4.
Mara clothing and quiet seated action remain coherent; no Ivo return, forced release, reunion or resolved personal case is depicted.
Rest head/front support drift and hand occlusion prevent reliable strand-by-strand continuity; the final braid cannot be accepted as a verified two-crossing physical sequence solely from this board.
Exact braid procedure is an art staging proposal, not mandated by N18-S01. N1 outcome and frozen follow-up conditions remain independent.

scope_reconciliation.NEW-N5-CLAMP-TRACES: targeted concept clue closed; geometry provisional
scope_reconciliation.FIX-67: still open: fixed-part length and translating carriage action
scope_reconciliation.FIX-74: three-end/rest readability improved; exact crossing topology remains open

limits: No game state, consent, rescue, safety, rewards or final engine asset validation is established by these pictures.
Not a global art acceptance or stopping decision.
